title.en: An Act to Consider the Late Ponciano Reyes and Lucio Diuquillo, Retired Under Act Numbered Twenty-Five Hundred and Eighty-Nine, as Amended.

text.en:
The late Ponciano Reyes, judge of the Court of First Instance of Zamboanga, and Lucio
Diuquillo, provincial treasurer of Masbate, who died in the performance of their official duties, are hereby
considered retired in accordance with the provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-five hundred and eighty-nine,
and for the purpose hereof, said retirement shall be as effective as if an application therefor had been filed
before June thirty, nineteen hundred and sixteen, and as if the same had been acted upon favorably prior to the
dates of their death.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 26, 1934.
